Mali.title: Mali.. Continuous operations of the army and the Azawad Front enter the line of battles of the sky
Mali.summary: The Malian Army announced the implementation of military operations in several areas of the country, which resulted in the targeting of a fuel depot northeast of Infrac, and a site for a gathering of armed elements west of Aguelhok, in addition to neutralizing a group of gunmen on motorcycles in the Dioula region in the south of the country. He said in an official statement on Sunday that the Malian armed forces, with the support of its partners, continue to monitor, sweep and secure the national territory within the framework of Operation Dogokoloko.

Mali.title: Massive Fuel Flow in Bamako: Over 5,300 Tanks Delivered Successfully!
Mali.summary: More than 5,300 tankers delivered in Bamako since September! This Saturday, October 10, 2026, a new convoy of 957 tankers arrived in the capital, escorted by our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa). The numbers speak for themselves: * September 2026 : 3,796 tankers arrived in Bamako in five convoys, including a record 1,289 tanks .

Mali.title: Sahel: The number of displaced in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger has almost doubled since 2020, according to UNHCR
Mali.summary: The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) warns of the displacement crisis in the Sahel: Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger now have nearly 4 million displaced persons and refugees, almost twice as many as in 2020, the year of the first military coup in Bamako . Published on: In Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, “security incidents have nearly doubled since 2020, weakening the state presence […] and increasing risks for both displaced people and host communities,” said Abdouraouf Gnon-Konde, UNHCR's Director for West and Central Africa, on Friday, 9 October .

Niger.title: Suspect arrested over farmer’s killing, kidnapping in Niger
Niger.summary: The police have arrested a 29-year-old man who allegedly contracted kidnappers to abduct and kill a large-scale farmer in Zawudna village, Munya Local Government Area, and took over the deceased’s farmland. The police said Godwin Yahaya was arrested following allegations by rescued kidnapping victims that he conspired with kidnappers to abduct the farmer, Jonah Isah, and others for ransom.

Niger.title: After sending aircraft to Niger… Shangarha confirms that “Algeria does not deal with the crises of the Sahel as an external actor but as an original partner”
Niger.summary: Algeria - “Arab Jerusalem”: The Chief of Staff of the Algerian Army, General Said Shangarha, stressed that Algeria does not deal with the crises of the Sahel as an external actor, but rather as an authentic partner who realizes that the stability of its neighbors is a prerequisite for its stability, in his first comment after the recent developments related to Algeria sending aircraft to help Niger confront a military coup In a speech during his visit to the third military region in the state of Bashar in southwestern Algeria, Shangarha said that Algeria's efforts to help the Sahel countries economically…

Niger.title: Zinder: eleven suspects arrested after the dismantling of two criminal networks
Niger.summary: Eleven individuals arrested, fifteen victims identified and three people actively wanted: the dismantling of two criminal networks by the Zinder Interregional Criminal Police Service reveals serial robberies in homes and markets, as well as a concealment circuit linking Zinder, Maradi and the surroundings of Takeita. The case started with an abandoned motorcycle in the Jacques Chirac district of Zinder .
